confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Alicante and Spanish price levels for July 2026, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July demand moves accommodation prices a lot. Cocktail and wine were set from their usual relationship to the beer anchor because direct local price knowledge for them is weaker. USD values reflect euro-level estimates converted at an approximate general-knowledge exchange rate, not a live quote. The FX observation comes from a search summary that cites the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Spanish Mediterranean coastal cities with similar tourism demand, such as Valencia and Malaga, with a modest downward adjustment for Alicante's smaller size. Hostel and hotel figures reflect July peak-season demand on the Costa Blanca.
